name: Memberships Frontend Registration
author: axiomsit142

sections.description:
WooCommerce Memberships Frontend Registration makes it easy to integrate WooCommerce Membership plan registrations directly on the frontend of your website with the following features:

  • Frontend Registration Shortcode: Use a shortcode to display a registration form for WooCommerce Memberships plans.
  • Admin Settings Validation: Ensure all required products for a membership plan are purchased before completing the membership.
  • Resume Membership Purchase: Show notifications on the member dashboard, allowing customers to complete any incomplete memberships after registration.
  • Automatic Cart Management: Automatically add required products or subscriptions to the cart when a customer registers for a membership plan.

This plugin simplifies the user journey and ensures a seamless experience for both administrators and customers.

Features

  1. Frontend Membership Registration:

    • Use the [msfr_custom_register] shortcode to display a custom membership registration page.
    • Includes validation to ensure all required products are linked to the selected membership plan.

  2. Admin Settings:

    • Verify that all required products for membership plans are configured properly.

  3. Notification System:

    • Show a dashboard notification prompting customers to complete their membership purchase process if they stopped after registration.

  4. Auto-Add Products to Cart:

    • Automatically add required products or subscription products to the cart when a customer registers for a membership plan.

  5. Shortcode-Driven Flexibility:

    • Place the registration form anywhere on your site using the [msfr_custom_register] shortcode.

Notes

This plugin requires WooCommerce and WooCommerce Memberships to function correctly.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install it via the WordPress Plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the plugin settings page to configure membership requirements and customize the registration process.
  4. Use the [msfr_custom_register] shortcode to display the registration form on your desired page.
sections.faq:
How do I display the registration page?

Use the shortcode [msfr_custom_register] on any page or post where you want to display the registration form.

What happens if a customer does not complete the membership purchase?

The plugin shows a notification on the member dashboard prompting them to complete the process. Clicking the link will redirect them to the checkout page to finish the purchase.

Does this plugin work with subscription products?

Yes, the plugin supports subscription products and automatically adds them to the cart during membership registration.

Can I use this plugin with custom membership plans?

Yes, as long as the plans are managed through WooCommerce Memberships, this plugin will work seamlessly.
